item.title: Same chassis, different oil
item.description: Two-voice cut on the Engine. One side: synthesis - music as field guide, rarity and frequency of decay, slam window, standing leak. The other: delta S as a negotiated chore wearing physics clothes, edge collusion, late burn as sociology. Reputation stays out of the XP mint. CT is a different meter. Oil in a rusted chassis vs a different scale.

item.title: The software manual inside Schrödinger's Flex
item.description:
Line-by-line on Schrödinger's Flex. The cat was a joke at people who scale quantum to a cat. Compute it or pipe down. Cosplay cosmos vs a functional manual. LocalFlow, DAG, did:key, XP = R × F × delta S × (w E) × log(1/Tₛ). Then the branch where he quit.
Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kRPKfqnjjFY Lyric video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2EZnlukCWfI

item.title: Homelessness is a signal loss crisis
item.description: NotebookLM deep dive on And That. Homelessness is not a housing shortage - it is what happens when every feedback loop goes deaf. Cash on symptoms, dodge causation. You cannot patch a soul with a voucher and a mat. DAG of verified delta S, XP as access not a cash-out. You cannot house a person back into a name.

item.title: Escaping the recursive loop of human control
item.description: Closing the Loop as systems audit. Determinism vs the glitch. Monkey middleware, MKUltra-to-algorithm, compression warfare, burn the arc, God as entropy reduced by love, homelessness as dead feedback. Are you writing the code or is it writing you?

item.title: The cold math of mild spanking
item.description: NotebookLM on the Mild Spanking Efficiency paper. Person-as-DAG, severity lock, XP vs settlement time, confounders (severity, genetics, child-evoked), Sweden 1979. Exploration of the argument, not an endorsement.
